title: Yummy Fluffy Turkish Soybean Sprout Revani
description: A buttery, fluffy revani infused with soybean sprouts and subtly fermented kimchi for an indulgent, lacto-vegetarian twist.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
In a bowl whisk soybean sprout flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl melt butter, then stir in soy milk, sugar, vanilla, and lemon zest until sugar dissolves.
Combine wet and dry mixtures, stirring until just blended; avoid overmixing.
Fold in pureed kimchi gently until evenly distributed.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25 minutes or until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.
While cake cools, prepare a simple syrup by dissolving 50 g sugar in 240 ml water over low heat.
Once the cake is cool, drizzle the syrup evenly over its surface.
Slice and serve warm or at room temperature, optionally dusting with powdered sugar.
Enjoy this buttery, fluffy, lacto-vegetarian dessert.
